### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized).
*   **Title Bar (Top Strip):** [0, 0, 1024, 45]. Contains App Icon/Name (Left), Utility Icons (Center-Right), Window Controls (Right).
*   **Sidebar (Left Pane):** [0, 46, 275, 944]. Vertical navigation list.
    *   *Header:* "Data Recovery" [15, 95].
    *   *Nav Items:* Hardware Disk, SD Card, More Recovery Tools. [5, 140] to [270, 320].
    *   *Section Header:* "Advanced Features" [15, 365].
    *   *Nav Items:* File Repair, Lost Partition Rescue. [5, 400] to [270, 520].
    *   *Section Header:* "File Backup" [15, 565].
    *   *Nav Item:* ChronoSnap Backup. [5, 600] to [270, 640].
*   **Main Content Area (Background):** [276, 46, 1024, 944]. Dimmed/Overlayed by modal.
    *   *Page Header:* "Select a location to search for lost data" + Refresh icon. [310, 105, 680, 150].
    *   *Device Grid:* Starts at [330, 250]. Two columns of device cards.
*   **Modal Dialog (Center Overlay):** [220, 170, 765, 675]. Centered on screen. White background, rounded corners, drop shadow.
    *   *Close Button:* Top-right corner of modal [735, 180, 755, 205].
    *   *Icon:* Large app icon centered at top [465, 230, 535, 315].
    *   *Title:* "Activate EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard" [365, 340, 635, 365].
    *   *Subtitle:* "Enter your license..." [310, 375, 690, 400].
    *   *Input Group:* [245, 415, 730, 495].
        *   *Paste Button:* Small blue button left of input [248, 408, 303, 450].
        *   *Input Field:* Text box [308, 410, 608, 450].
        *   *Activate Button:* Primary blue button right of input [613, 410, 725, 450].
    *   *Note Text:* "Note: No reinstallation..." [245, 505, 580, 525].
    *   *Footer Link:* "Don't have a license?" [430, 565, 565, 585].
    *   *CTA Button:* "Buy a License Now" (Yellow) [410, 595, 590, 640].
*   **Taskbar (Bottom):** [0, 945, 1024, 1000]. Windows 11 centered layout.

### 2. TEXT
*   **Title Bar:** "EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free"
*   **Sidebar:**
    *   "Data Recovery"
    *   "Hardware Disk"
    *   "SD Card"
    *   "More Recovery Tools"
    *   "Advanced Features"
    *   "File Repair"
    *   "Lost Partition Rescue"
    *   " File Backup"
    *   "ChronoSnap Backup"
*   **Main Area (Background):**
    *   "Select a location to search for lost data"
    *   "Device Detection"
    *   "...following scenarios:" (partially obscured)
    *   "...nd you are confused." (partially obscured)
    *   "Windows(C:)"
    *   "31.34 GB /149.45 GB"
    *   "Search Entire Disk"
    *   "Msft Virtual Disk"
    *   "150 GB"
    *   "Cont..." (partially obscured)
    *   "Search Entire Disk"
    *   "Temporary Storage("
    *   "146.12 GB /150 GB"
    *   "Got it"
*   **Modal (Foreground):**
    *   "Activate EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard"
    *   "Enter your license to enjoy full features and unlimited recovery."
    *   "Paste"
    *   "Enter license code \"XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX\"..."
    *   "Activate"
    *   "Note: No reinstallation or rescan required after activation."
    *   "Don't have a license?"
    *   "Buy a License Now"

### 3. COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window BG: `#E8EBF0` (Light Blue-Grey)
    *   Sidebar BG: `#F0F2F5` (Slightly lighter grey)
    *   Modal BG: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Input Field BG: `#F5F5F5` (Light Grey)
*   **Accents & Buttons:**
    *   Primary Blue (Activate/Search): `#1677FF` or `#1890FF`
    *   Secondary Yellow/Gold (Buy): `#FFC107` or `#FFD54F` (Gradient likely `#FFD700` to `#FFA000`)
    *   Paste Button Blue: `#1677FF` (Same as primary)
    *   Selection Highlight (Sidebar): `#D6E4FF` (Very light blue)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text: `#1F1F1F` or `#333333`
    *   Secondary/Subtitle Text: `#666666` or `#888888`
    *   Placeholder Text: `#AAAAAA`
    *   White Text (on Blue): `#FFFFFF`
*   **Borders:**
    *   Input Border: `#D9D9D9`
    *   Modal Shadow: `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)` blur ~20px

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Modal Title:** Sans-Serif (Segoe UI/Inter), ~18px, Bold (600-700 weight).
*   **Modal Subtitle/Body:** Sans-Serif, ~13px, Regular (400), Line height ~1.5.
*   **Button Text:** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Medium (500).
*   **Input Placeholder:** Sans-Serif, ~13px.
*   **Sidebar Items:** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Regular. Selected item is Bold/Darker.
*   **Device Tile Name:** Sans-Serif, ~15px, Bold.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Modal Dimensions:** Width ~545px, Height ~500px.
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Modal: ~8px - 10px.
    *   Buttons/Input: ~6px (rounded rect).
*   **Padding:**
    *   Modal Internal Padding: ~40px (sides), ~30px (top/bottom).
    *   Input Field Padding: ~10px horizontal, ~8px vertical.
*   **Control Heights:**
    *   Input Field / Buttons: ~38px - 42px.
    *   Sidebar Item Height: ~48px.
*   **Icons:**
    *   Modal Main Icon: ~80x80px.
    *   Sidebar Icons: ~24x24px.
    *   Device Icons: ~48x48px.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Modal:**
    *   **Type:** Activation/License Dialog.
    *   **State:** Open, Active (focused window). Background is disabled/dimmed (Overlay state).
    *   **Input:** Text Field (Empty/Placeholder state).
    *   **Buttons:**
        *   "Paste": Normal (Blue background, white text).
        *   "Activate": Normal (Primary style).
        *   "Buy a License Now": Normal (Warning/Accent style).
        *   Close 'X': Normal.
*   **Sidebar:**
    *   **"Hardware Disk":** Selected State (Blue left border indicator, blue text, checkmark badge).
    *   **Other items:** Normal state.
*   **Main Area:**
    *   **Device Tiles:** Normal state.
    *   **"Search Entire Disk" buttons:** Normal state.
    *   **"Got it" button:** Normal state (likely a toast or tip dismissal).

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, "Filled" or "Dual-tone" (using brand colors), modern vector style.
*   **Modal Icon:** Blue folder/bag with a medical cross (representing recovery/repair).
*   **Sidebar Icons:**
    *   Hardware Disk: Blue grid/folder.
    *   SD Card: Grey SD card shape.
    *   Tools: Wrench/Screwdriver.
    *   File Repair: Folder with tool/magic wand.
    *   Partition: Globe/Network node style.
    *   Backup: Circular arrows (refresh style).

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Modal Interrupt / Overlay State**. The underlying application is in an "Initial" or "Selection" state (waiting for user to pick a drive), but the user flow is currently blocked by the "Activation" requirement dialog.
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot). The dimming of the background suggests a modal transition has completed.
